name: franken-crew
description: Self-healing Linux server sentry: deterministic Go kernel reflexes (cgroup v2, PSI, memory.events), Kiro Crew agents that triage, plan, and execute on events, and Ed25519 WhatsApp approval gates.
author: FikFikk
highlights: Go Sentinel watches PSI, cgroup v2 memory.events, and journald, and applies one reversible L1 reflex with a TTL and persistent rollback.
A conductor agent wakes on wa-bridge webhooks and runs the Sentry, Architect, and Remediator specialists for triage, planning, and execution.
Every L2 step needs a policy-checked plan and its own single-use Ed25519 token, minted only when an allowlisted admin votes in a WhatsApp poll.
The Graveyard page replays incidents: telemetry, swimlanes, agent chatter, the approval poll, verification, and the postmortem.

crons.name: incident-sweep
crons.message:
FRANKENCREW phase=SWEEP
Safety net for missed webhooks: wa-bridge triggers TRIAGE and EXECUTE phases on events. Run the franken-conductor SWEEP procedure: list incidents and triage only P1, P2, or POST_OOM incidents still in DETECTED or REFLEX_APPLIED. Do nothing when none are pending.

crons.name: morning-digest
crons.message: Call incident_list and node_snapshot to summarize deferred P3 memory pressure warnings and 24-hour node health stability, then send one concise redacted digest (<= 700 chars) via wa_notify with severity='P3'.
